in_sanskrit.name: Kashim
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Golden, Shining
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kashim एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word काश् (Kāśh) meaning 'golden, shining'. This name holds deep significance in Hindu mythology, associated with the radiant God Kashyapa.

in_hindi.name: कशिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has the moon as water or a person who is cool like the moon

in_tamil.name: Kashim
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Golden, Shining
in_tamil.long_meaning: Kashim ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word काश् (Kāśh) meaning 'golden, shining'. This name holds deep significance in Hindu mythology, associated with the radiant God Kashyapa.

in_telugu.name: Kashim
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kashim ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word काश् (Kāśh) meaning 'golden, shining'. This name holds deep significance in Hindu mythology, associated with the radiant God Kashyapa.

in_marathi.name: Kashim
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kashim हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word काश् (Kāśh) meaning 'golden, shining'. This name holds deep significance in Hindu mythology, associated with the radiant God Kashyapa.

in_bengali.name: Kashim
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Golden, Shining
